title: The Coloured Sand Theorem: the p-part of the sandpile group of the Hamming graph, for every prime p dividing q and every dimension d
summary: Let $H(d,q)=K_q^{d}$ be the Hamming graph and $K(H(d,q))$ its sandpile group (critical group, Jacobian). For primes $p\nmid q$ its $p$-part was determined by Jacobson, Niedermaier and Reiner in 2003, who wrote that the other primes appear "to be difficult, due to bad behavior of its $p$-primary structure". We determine the Sylow $p$-subgroup of $K(H(d,q))$ for every prime $p$ dividing $q$ and every $d$, by an explicit rule.
